create_DataLoaderMap: create a DataLoaderMap dataclass to hold train, val, and test data loaders for Implicitron
build_SimpleDataLoaderMapProvider: build a SimpleDataLoaderMapProvider to create shuffled batch data loaders from a DatasetMap
create_DoublePoolBatchSampler: create a DoublePoolBatchSampler to sample batches with one frame from a first pool and conditioning frames from a rest pool
build_SequenceDataLoaderMapProvider: build a SequenceDataLoaderMapProvider to create data loaders with configurable conditioning types for sequence-based frame sampling
review_BatchConditioningType: review the BatchConditioningType enum to understand SAME, TRAIN, and KNOWN conditioning strategies for val and test batches
